faq.q: How much does Mark Morais charge?
faq.a: Mark Morais publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Mark Morais offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Mark Morais does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does Mark Morais have offices?
faq.a: Mark Morais publishes one office, in Miami. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Mark Morais?
faq.a: Mark Morais names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.
